findings.title: Received enablement becomes shared capacity
findings.claim: The Lord-given enablement is read as operative capacity that a ruler turns into shared protective work, so the offered payment is answered by participation rather than purchased labor.
findings.mechanism: The carrier rbb names the speaker's Lord as the source of authority, mkn names the received ability to act, khayr evaluates that received provision, and the fa plus practical-help imperative redirects the value claim into supplied strength. The wider repair and better-provision connections return through these focus forms and extend the reading from private capacity to public construction.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can perceive power as a received means that multiplies through capable participation rather than replacing the community's work.
findings.containment: This adds a relation between received authority, value, and shared construction; it does not establish a universal political theory or claim that every form of payment is excluded.

epistemic.reason: The trusted cross-run support directly anchors the Rabb and khayr relation at the focus, while the legacy reader records are retained as corroborating qualifications and the wider connections are discovery evidence rather than automatic verdicts.

branch_activations.resulting_reading: Public authority appears as received enabling care that becomes practical protection.
branch_activations.boundary: This does not claim that every exercise of authority is just or that human agency disappears.

findings.title: A barrier repairs the interval between groups
findings.claim: The requested barrier can also be perceived as repair of a breach in the relation between two groups: it closes an opening while the rdm image permits a joined, patched structure made through shared effort.
findings.mechanism: The rdm carrier names both filling a gap and, in its qualified extension, patching worn material; the two bayn phrases define the relational interval, while the help and strength imperatives provide the independent communal trigger. Wider references to corruption, repelling harm, and cooperation return through this barrier-and-help relation.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader sees the barrier as a response to a damaged social interval, not only as an isolated object placed between two points.
findings.containment: The repair image supplements the ordinary spatial act of closing an opening; it does not claim that the barrier is literally textile or that the contextual extension replaces the physical reading.

epistemic.reason: The trusted support anchors rdm at the focus but is graded weak, while the legacy activation and the wider connections support the communal-repair relation without supplying a fully independent lexical proof for every extension facet.

branch_activations.independent_trigger: The two between-phrases establish the opposed endpoints, and the wider corruption and repelling-harm references supply the protective problem.
branch_activations.activation: The barrier carrier contacts the relational endpoints and the wider prevention-of-corruption trigger, changing a wall from a neutral separator into a protective closure.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The construction answers a breach that threatens a community and closes the passage through which harm would enter.
branch_activations.boundary: This remains a protective closure; it does not import every possible social or architectural meaning of rdm.

findings.title: Layered protection remains bounded
findings.claim: The later construction sequence lets rdm carry a qualified layered-repair resonance: protection is assembled to hold back passage, then remains bounded by the promised end of that protection.
findings.mechanism: The retrospective support connects the focus rdm to the layered pieces, blocked passage, and 18:98 endpoint; the sequel connection at 18:99 independently returns the barrier to its appointed release. The same focus carrier therefore holds both the repair image and the limit placed on its duration.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader perceives durability as functional and time-bound: a protection can be carefully made without becoming absolute or permanent.
findings.containment: This keeps the physical barrier as the primary scene and treats cloth-like layering and bounded duration as contextual resonance; it does not claim that rdm literally means cloth or that the barrier fails before its appointed end.

epistemic.reason: The only direct retrospective support is legacy-unbound, while the supplied focus and sequel connection provide a concrete carrier and endpoint trigger; the layered image therefore remains qualified rather than fully grounded.
